placements.why: Establishes the organization's operational resilience tier, grounding system reliability and recovery mechanisms in proactive practice and verification.
placements.title: Operational reliability and recovery are maintained through continuous verification
placements.frame: How does the organization structure, test, and guarantee resilience and recovery mechanisms across its systems?

placements.title: Rollback capabilities are only genuine when verified through recurring rehearsal
placements.frame: How does regular rehearsal distinguish active recovery capabilities from unverified theoretical procedures?
placements.why: Quinton mandates monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals, anchoring the policy in the operational principle that unpracticed capabilities do not functionally exist.
